title: The Boy Who Grew with the Land

style_reference.visual_style: Cinematic 35mm film still, warm golden morning light, fine organic grain, soft highland mist, centered composition, authentic Ethiopian rural heritage
style_reference.character_description: A 10-year-old Ethiopian highland boy with gentle determined eyes, wearing a simple traditional earth-toned cotton vest and shorts, barefoot, natural skin texture
style_reference.color_palette: Highland ochre, terracota red soil, lush emerald green pastures, amber sunrise, misty blue distant peaks

music_cues.caption: Deeply moving Ethiopian acoustic folk score, gentle traditional washint flute, warm acoustic guitar, reflective nostalgic strings, unhurried and cinematic

shots.visual_prompt: Cinematic landscape of the Ethiopian highlands at dawn. Rolling green terraced hills, distant blue mountains, morning mist drifting across eucalyptus and acacia trees. Soft golden sunrise light, 35mm film grain, centered framing.
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pans slowly from left to right across the vast misty valley, morning fog rises gently, quiet still morning feeling.

narration.text: ከከተሞች ጩኸት እና ከዘመናዊው አለም ውጣ ውረድ በፊት፣ በኢትዮጵያ ገጠራማ ምድር ያደገ አንድ ትንሽ ልጅ ነበር።
narration.subtitles_en: Long before the noise of busy cities, a young boy was growing up in the Ethiopian countryside.

shots.reason: Establishes place, tranquility, and scale of the Ethiopian countryside before modern life.

shots.visual_prompt: A young 10-year-old Ethiopian boy stepping barefoot onto dew-covered green grass outside a traditional stone thatched cottage. Cool morning mist, amber dawn sunlight hitting his face. Centered framing.
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in gently as he steps onto the damp grass, looking out towards the rising sun with quiet calm.

narration.text: የልጅነት አለሙ በውድ መጫወቻዎች የተከበበ አልነበረም፤ በመስኩ አረንጓዴ፣ በተራራው ንጹህ አየር እና በገጠር ህይወት ሰላማዊ ዜማ እንጂ።
narration.subtitles_en: His childhood was not surrounded by toys, but by green fields, morning air, and village peace.

shots.reason: Introduces the young protagonist and his intimate connection with nature.

shots.visual_prompt: The young Ethiopian shepherd boy holding a wooden walking stick, guiding a flock of sheep and cattle across open highland pastures. Soft morning sunbeams piercing through scattered clouds, lush rolling hills.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tracking shot following the cattle grazing across the green pasture, boy walking steadily beside them, wind rustling the grass.

narration.text: ፀሐይ ከተራራው ጀርባ ስትወጣ፣ ከብቶችን እየነዳ ወደ ሜዳው ያመራል። ረዣዥም ቀናት አድካሚ ቢሆኑም፣ ገጠሩ የራሱ የሆነ ውበት ነበረው።
narration.subtitles_en: As the sun rose behind the hills, he guided the cattle across the pastures. The long days were tiring, but the countryside had its own beauty.

shots.reason: Depicts childhood responsibility, cattle herding, and daily patience.

shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of the young boy's sun-browned hands tenderly nurturing delicate green seedlings in freshly tilled rich red earth. Sunlight glistening on morning dew and fertile dark soil, organic farming texture, cinematic depth of field.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tilt up from his hands carefully patting the soil around the young sprout to his focused, respectful expression.

narration.text: አፈሩን አርሶ ዘርን ማብቀል፣ ለእሱ የህይወት ትምህርት ቤት ነበር። እያንዳንዱ የተዘራ ዘር ተስፋን፣ እያንዳንዱ የሰብል ወቅት ደግሞ ትዕግስትን እና ብርታትን አስተማረው።
narration.voice_style: natural, warm, unhurried human storyteller, speaking with gentle heartfelt emotion
narration.subtitles_en: Cultivating seeds and tilling the soil became his school of life. Every seed sown carried hope, and every harvest cycle taught patience and strength.

shots.reason: Core agricultural focus: tilling the soil, cultivating seeds, and learning life lessons through the growth of crops.

shots.visual_prompt: Traditional Ethiopian highland harvest scene. Neighbors and families working side by side in the golden teff field, traditional straw hats, women carrying clay water jugs, communal spirit of Debo. Warm golden hour light.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow panoramic pan across the communal harvest field, farmers cutting and tying grain together in shared harmony.

narration.text: በዚያን ጊዜ ህይወት በህብረት የተገነባ ነበር። ቤተሰብ አብሮ ይሰራል፣ ጎረቤት ለጎረቤት ይደጋገፋል፣ ማህበረሰቡም ያለውን ይካፈላል።
narration.subtitles_en: In those days, life was built on togetherness. Families worked side by side, neighbors supported one another, sharing whatever they had.

shots.reason: Celebrates Ethiopian communal values, solidarity, and Debo labor culture.

shots.visual_prompt: Close-up portrait of the 10-year-old Ethiopian boy resting for a moment under a wild olive tree. Sweat glistening softly on his forehead, a genuine peaceful smile, kind eyes reflecting the golden sky. Centered framing.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in towards his eyes, a gentle breeze moves a lock of hair, subtle breathing and quiet content smile.

narration.text: ኃላፊነትን ከእንስሳቱ፣ ጽናትን ደግሞ ከመሬቱ ተማረ። ምንም አይነት የክፍል ትምህርት ሊያስተምረው የማይችለውን ታላቅ ጥበብ።
narration.subtitles_en: He learned responsibility from animals, and determination from the fields—lessons no classroom could ever teach.

shots.reason: Emotional peak showing his inner character and dignity being formed.

shots.visual_prompt: The young boy standing at the crest of a green highland ridge at golden sunset, looking out towards the distant horizon where mountains meet the twilight sky. Silhouetted against warm amber and violet light.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera pull-back from behind the boy as the sunset deepens, looking into the expansive future.

narration.text: ዓመታት አለፉ። በመስኩ በባዶ እግሩ ይጓዝ የነበረው ያ ትንሽ ልጅ ወደ ትልቅ ሰውነት ተቀየረ። ነገር ግን ያ ያሳለፈው ህይወት ዛሬም በውስጡ ህያው ነው።
narration.voice_style: solemn, respectful, bridging past to present
narration.subtitles_en: Years passed. The little barefoot boy who roamed the fields became a man, but the lessons of his childhood remain alive in him today.

shots.reason: The bridge from past childhood to present manhood and character.

shots.visual_prompt: A solitary majestic ancient sycamore tree on the Ethiopian plateau under twilight stars and glowing embers of sunset. Red earth pathway with faint footsteps leading forward. Cinematic, timeless, peaceful.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow aerial rise revealing the enduring beauty of the land beneath the vast Ethiopian night sky.

narration.text: አንዳንዶች ሀብትን ይወርሳሉ፣ አንዳንዶች እውቀትን፤ አባቴ ግን የመሬቱን ብርታት ወረሰ። እኔም በኩራት የማስታውሰው ትሩፋት ይኸው ነው።
narration.subtitles_en: Some people inherit wealth, some inherit knowledge, but my father inherited the strength of the land—and that is a legacy I will always be proud of.

shots.reason: The climax and legacy punchline honoring the father and his enduring strength.
